name: @imenam/mcp-design

scripts.build:gui: cd gui && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:gui
scripts.release: npm version patch && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.build:standalone: cd gui && npm install && npm run build:standalone

author: Imena
description: MCP server providing a simple design canvas: the agent creates shapes and text, the user refines them in a GUI, and the agent picks the edits back up.
